text: どの　ポケモンに　おぼえさせるか　よく　かんがえた　ほうが　いい　ところで…　わざマシン３９には　がんせきふうじ　が　はいっている！

structure.jp: どの　ポケモンに　おぼえさせるか
structure.en: which Pokémon to teach it to

structure.jp: よく　かんがえた　ほうが　いい
わざマシン３９には　がんせきふうじ　が　はいっている！

patterns.name: 〜たほうがいい
patterns.span: かんがえた　ほうが　いい
patterns.explanation: A past-form verb plus ほうがいい gives advice: 'you had better do this'. かんがえた　ほうが　いい = 'you had better think'.

patterns.name: 〜か (embedded question)
patterns.span: どの　ポケモンに　おぼえさせるか
patterns.explanation: か after a question tucked inside a bigger sentence turns it into 'which one' or 'whether' as a thing to think about. どの　ポケモンに　おぼえさせるか = 'which Pokémon to teach it to'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる on a verb says you make or let someone do it. おぼえさせる = 'make it learn', that is, 'teach'.
